theme_and_archetype.rationale: Premium travel needs warmth, trust, and a luxurious feel. The existing Xaluca Tours palette perfectly embodies this with cream backgrounds and rich espresso/gold accents.

h1.classes: font-serif text-5xl md:text-6xl tracking-tight text-[#1A1513] leading-[1.1]

h2.classes: font-serif text-3xl md:text-4xl tracking-tight text-[#1A1513] leading-[1.2]

eyebrow.classes: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-[#D4A373] flex items-center gap-4 before:content-[''] before:w-8 before:h-[1px] before:bg-[#D4A373]

spacing_and_layout.section_padding: py-20 md:py-32 px-6 md:px-12 max-w-7xl mx-auto
spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: 2x2 on desktop, 1x4 on mobile. 4 columns on desktop would compress the content too much and violate the 'generous whitespace' principle. A 2x2 grid allows the inclusions list and descriptions to breathe.

PricingHero.description: Left-aligned asymmetric intro band. Includes the eyebrow, H1, and persuasive subtitle. Background can have subtle berber pattern.

PackageCard.classes: relative bg-white border border-[#5C5248]/15 rounded-sm flex flex-col h-full transition-transform duration-500 hover:-translate-y-2 hover:shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgba(26,21,19,0.05)]
inner_structure: Header: Badge (if recommended) + Title + Duration/Region Meta
Body: Short persuasive text + Price block + Divider line
Footer: Primary CTA (Pill shape, Espresso) + Secondary CTA (Text link, Gold hover)

Badge.classes: absolute -top-4 left-8 bg-[#C16542] text-white text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest py-1.5 px-4 rounded-full shadow-sm

Buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-[#1A1513] text-[#FDFBF7] px-8 py-4 text-sm uppercase tracking-widest hover:bg-[#C16542] transition-colors duration-300 w-full text-center flex justify-center items-center gap-2 group
Buttons.secondary: mt-4 text-center w-full text-sm font-medium text-[#1A1513] underline decoration-[#D4A373]/50 underline-offset-4 hover:decoration-[#D4A373] transition-all

hero.title: Encuentra tu estilo de aventura
hero.subtitle: Cuatro maneras únicas de vivir la magia de Marruecos. Precios transparentes, flexibilidad total y la garantía de una experiencia Xaluca diseñada a tu medida.

packages.title: La magia del Sur
packages.description: Adéntrate en las dunas doradas del Sahara y descubre la hospitalidad bereber en nuestros campamentos de lujo.
inclusions: Alojamiento en Hoteles Xaluca y Bivouacs

packages.title: Marruecos de norte a sur
packages.description: El gran viaje. Desde las vibrantes medinas del norte hasta la inmensidad del desierto y la costa atlántica.

packages.title: Escapadas cortas
packages.description: Perfecto para fines de semana largos. Sumérgete en la cultura marroquí sin necesidad de muchos días.

packages.title: La riqueza del Norte
packages.description: Explora el encanto azul de Chefchaouen, la historia de Fez y la brisa mediterránea de Tánger.

trust_section.title: Términos de la Experiencia
trust_section.content: Los precios indicados son orientativos y varían según la temporada (alta/baja) y el número de viajeros. Están calculados en base a ocupación doble o triple. Todos nuestros viajes son 100% personalizables y sin compromiso. Contacta con nosotros para un presupuesto exacto adaptado a tus fechas.

hero_background.description: Subtle desert dune backdrop for the hero section. Apply heavy cream tint/overlay (#FDFBF7 at 90% opacity) so the text remains perfectly legible.

trust_section_image.description: Architectural Riad detail for the trust section. Best used as an aside image or subtle watermark.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the /precios route using pure React/Tailwind for the layouts to match the custom premium marketing feel. Do NOT use Shadcn if it forces a generic SaaS look.
Build the PackageCard from scratch using `div` elements, applying the specified thin borders (border_light), pill buttons, and hover transform (`-translate-y-2`).
Use a 2x2 grid (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2`) for the 4 packages. Do not cram them into 4 columns on desktop. They need space to look premium.
Ensure `data-testid` attributes are added to all interactive elements (e.g., `data-testid="package-magia-sur-cta"`).

The hero section should have an asymmetrical, left-aligned layout with the provided eyebrow, H1, and subtitle. Apply a very subtle grain or the provided Unsplash image with a 90% cream overlay behind it.
Use the exact color hex codes provided in the JSON. Add them to the Tailwind config or as arbitrary values if needed.
Create a custom checkmark SVG for the inclusions list using the `accent_gold` color (#D4A373).
